instruction: Ensure the badge image at the top right of the first slide is positioned above all other items.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires bringing Picture 3 (the badge image) to the front. Verified that slide 1 has 7 shapes total, so Picture 3 should be at index 5-6 when brought to front (last or near-last position in the shapes collection). The evaluator checks z-order with a range to account for different bring-to-front implementations.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts z-order index of Picture 3 from slide 0
Metric logic correctly compares z-order index against min/max constraints
Postconfig appropriately saves file to persist z-order changes

Expected value range (5-6) is slightly imprecise: instruction requires image 'on top of ALL other elements' which should strictly be index 6 only (highest position), but range 5-6 allows second-to-front position
The range tolerance may be intentional to handle implementation variations, but could allow false positives where image is not fully at front
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider using exact expected index of 6 instead of range 5-6 to match instruction's absolute requirement ('appears on top of all other elements')
If range is needed for legitimate implementation variations, add metadata explanation of why index 5 is acceptable
